name: Erg Session — Four Rowers, Two Machines
description: Four rowers (A, B, C, D), two ergs, one coach. A+B warm up on the machines, C+D take them ten minutes later. Three 4-minute pieces per pair at rate 26-28, target split on the monitor: A+B row first, C+D take each piece straight off the back of A+B's, and A+B's 4-minute rests are exactly C+D's pieces. The rests are deliberately NOT steps — they are the handover gaps between one piece ending and the next starting, which is the whole design of the session. Then 3-minute coached technique drills one rower at a time in the order A, B, C, D, ten minutes on the floor together, then the debrief. Limits are constraints, not copied steps: the bay of two ergs holds exactly one pair at a time (erg-bay, maxConcurrent 1 — a pair occupies both machines, and nobody sits on a machine they are not rowing), one coach so only one rower is on the coached drill at a time (coach, maxConcurrent 1), and all four rowers share the floor (floor, maxConcurrent 4). The three pieces per pair are one replicated step each: A+B hold an 8-minute stagger (4 min rowing + their 4 min rest = C+D's piece), and C+D's pieces are an each-chain that fires instance-for-instance off the back of A+B's, so the machines are never idle and never shared.

tracks.name: Erg bay — two machines, one pair at a time

steps.name: A+B warm-up — 10 min, rate 18, light pressure, half to full slide
C+D warm-up — 10 min, on the machines A+B have just left
Piece (A+B) — 4 min, rate 26-28, target split; 4 min rest follows (C+D row it)
Piece (C+D) — straight off the back of A+B's piece, then hand back
Brief the crew on the boards — before anyone gets on
Call splits from the first piece — 20 min on the clock, watch the catch not the monitor
Run the drills — 3 min each, one rower at a time: A, then B, then C, then D
Debrief — what the splits said and what Saturday looks like
Cooldown — 10 min on the floor, legs up the wall, hips, lats, cup of tea
